input: Research tandem skydiving jump packages nearby

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's location or region determines which drop zones are actually 'nearby' and shapes the entire search.
Budget heavily filters which packages are worth considering — entry-level jumps vs. premium experiences vary widely in price.
Some packages include add-ons like video/photo, higher altitudes, or gear rental; knowing what to include or exclude focuses the comparison.
Whether this is for one person or a group affects pricing tiers, group discounts, and coordination logistics.
The intended jump date or timeframe determines availability, seasonal pricing, and how urgently the research needs to happen.
Priorities like instructor reputation, safety certifications, altitude height, or scenery change which packages rank highest.
Knowing what 'done' looks like — a shortlist, a booking, a price comparison doc — determines how deep the research needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Research tandem skydiving jump packages nearby
gold.taskDescription: Find and compare tandem skydiving jump packages at drop zones near the user's location.

questions.title: What city or region should the search be centered on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred area so only genuinely nearby drop zones are included in the research.

questions.title: What is your total budget per person for the jump?
questions.description: Establish a price ceiling to filter out packages that are out of range and highlight those that offer the best value within budget.

questions.title: Should packages include photo or video recording options?
questions.description: Determine whether media add-ons are a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant so the scope of comparison is clear.

questions.title: Is this jump for just you, or a group of people?
questions.description: Clarify the number of participants, as group bookings often unlock discounts and require different logistics.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or weekend in mind?
questions.description: Pin down the intended timeframe to check availability, seasonal schedules, and any advance-booking requirements.

questions.title: What matters most — altitude, safety ratings, or instructor experience?
questions.description: Understand the user's top priority so packages can be ranked and recommended according to what they value most.

questions.title: Do you want a shortlist to compare, or to make a booking?
questions.description: Define what a successful outcome looks like — a research summary, a ranked list, or an actual reservation — to scope the depth of work needed.
